item.title: Hokkaido Mystery Guide: Escape Rooms, Goryokaku's Last Republic & Ainu Secrets
item.description: Hokkaido’s mysteries operate at an unusual intersection of the very recent (150 years of recorded colonial history) and the very ancient (10,000+ years of Ainu culture that the colonisation systematically attempted to erase). The island’s short institutional history means the historical record is remarkably complete — Enomoto Takeaki’s Republic of Ezo lasted less than a year and is documented in extraordinary detail — while the Ainu cultural codes embedded in Hokkaido’s landscape names have only recently begun to be properly interpreted.
